title: Baron Jump
instructions: By moving in a direction, using an Artifact then rolling and jumping simultaneously on the next frame, you can effectively DuckJump from anywhere, with an additional block of height.
notes:
Jump timing: After initiating a Baron Slide or Hyper Baron Slide, there is a brief window to input jump; jumping does not have to be simultaneous with the roll. You can roll off platforms or cliffs, or over pits, and still jump midair.

FPS: Slide distance in both variants depends on FPS. Around 60 FPS is ideal for noticeably greater initial momentum.
